verdict.rationale: WorkOS's own migration tooling handles many items at once: the CLI migrations tool exports Auth0 data into a package of users, organizations, memberships and roles, which is then imported via the AuthKit API. That is a narrow, one-off migration use case rather than general bulk operations over live workspace items. Nothing shows the API, MCP server or dashboard offering batch update, delete or other multi-item actions. Missing for 10: general-purpose bulk/batch API endpoints, bulk actions via the MCP server or dashboard, documented batch limits or semantics, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: This produces a migration package with users, organizations, memberships, roles, SSO handoff files, and warnings.
The fastest way to export Auth0 data is with the WorkOS CLI migrations tool
we will walk through the steps to export, and then import your users, organizations, and enterprise SSO connections from Auth0.
